articles.headline: On the Strait of Hormuz, BBC finds seized ships and shark fishermen as uneasy calm returns
articles.summary: The BBC visits Bandar Abbas to see how the US-Israeli war with Iran has affected everyday life in the port city.
articles._summary: BBC reports from the Strait of Hormuz during fragile ceasefire It's a sweltering summer's day and fishermen are unloading their catch on the docks. One proudly holds several baby sharks tangled in his nets. Shark sandwich is a local delicacy, he explains. Another rides off with two large fish strung over his motorbike. In many ways this looks like an ordinary fishing port, but the docks are in Bandar Abbas, an Iranian city on the Strait of Hormuz, one of the world's most vital shipping lanes and a key focal point of the US-Israeli war with Iran. This is the first time international journalists have visited the Iranian side of the strait since the conflict began. When the US and Israel launched attacks on 28 February, the Iranian regime responded by attacking Israel and neighbouring Gulf states hosting US forces and turned its geography into one of its greatest sources of leverage.
articles._zh_headline: 在霍尔木兹海峡，随着不安的平静回归，BBC 发现了被扣押的船只和鲨鱼渔民
articles._zh_summary: 英国广播公司 (BBC) 在脆弱的停火期间从霍尔木兹海峡报道，这是一个闷热的夏日，渔民正在码头上卸货。一名男子自豪地将几条小鲨鱼缠在他的网中。他解释说，鲨鱼三明治是当地的一道美食。另一个人骑着摩托车走了，他的摩托车上挂着两条大鱼。从很多方面来看，这看起来就像一个普通的渔港，但码头位于霍尔木兹海峡上的伊朗城市阿巴斯港，霍尔木兹海峡是世界上最重要的航道之一，也是美以与伊朗战争的关键焦点。这是冲突爆发以来国际记者首次访问海峡伊朗一侧。当美国和以色列于 2 月 28 日发动袭击时，伊朗政权的回应是攻击以色列和驻有美军的海湾邻国，并将其地理位置变成其最大的筹码来源之一。

articles.author: Piero Cingari
articles.headline: Dow Hits Records as Money Rotates Out of AI Chips Into Blue Chips: This Week on Wall Street
articles.summary: Dow hits record highs as weak jobs data cools rate-hike fears, Warsh debuts in Sintra, Magnificent Seven rebound, and Nike beats earnings.
articles._summary: As America approaches its 250th birthday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average — the oldest U.S. stock market index — capped a holiday-shortened week at fresh record highs, surpassing 52,500 points on Thursday . The rally reflected a great rotation from AI capex names into the blue-chip industrials, benefiting from that same spending wave. Job growth cooled sharply in June, with payrolls rising just 57,000 — well below the 115,000 consensus and down from a revised 129,000 in May.
articles._zh_headline: 随着资金从人工智能芯片转向蓝筹股，道琼斯指数创下历史新高：本周华尔街
articles._zh_summary: 随着美国诞辰 250 周年的临近，道琼斯工业平均指数（美国历史最悠久的股市指数）在假期缩短的一周中创下新的历史新高，周四突破 52,500 点。此次上涨反映了从人工智能资本支出名称转向蓝筹工业的巨大轮换，受益于同样的支出浪潮。 6 月份就业增长急剧降温，就业人数仅增加 57,000 人，远低于市场预期的 115,000 人，也低于 5 月份修正后的 129,000 人。

articles.author: Chris Katje
articles.headline: EXCLUSIVE: Market Expert Jay Woods Says Micron Stock is New Market ‘Tell,’ Following Footsteps of Nvidia, Apple, Microsoft
articles.summary: Market expert Jay Woods makes his predictions for the S&P 500 in the second half of 2026 and tells Benzinga Micron is now the stock to watch.
articles._summary: • Micron Technology stock is feeling bearish pressure. Why is MU stock dropping? Similar to making changes to top stocks midway through the year, Woods is slightly tweaking his forecast for the S&P 500 for the rest of 2026. "I give those end-of-year targets for fun and I don’t like to change them in the middle of the year," Woods tells Benzinga in an exclusive interview. With the S&P 500 trading near 7,500 at the time of the interview, Woods said it’s hard to know if the market index has peaked for 2026.
articles._zh_headline: 独家报道：市场专家杰伊·伍兹 (Jay Woods) 称美光科技股票是追随英伟达、苹果、微软脚步的新市场“信号”
articles._zh_summary: • 美光科技股票正感受到看跌压力。 MU股价为何下跌？与年中对顶级股票进行调整类似，伍兹略微调整了他对 2026 年剩余时间标准普尔 500 指数的预测。“我给出这些年终目标是为了好玩，我不喜欢在年中改变它们，”伍兹在独家采访中告诉本辛加。伍兹表示，在接受采访时，标准普尔 500 指数接近 7,500 点，很难知道市场指数是否已在 2026 年见顶。

articles.author: Piero Cingari
articles.headline: SOXX ETF's Worst 2-Day Drop in Over a Year: These 3 Chip Stocks Now Screen with 50% Upside
articles.summary: Semiconductors just posted their sharpest two-day slide since March 2025. The overbought signal that defined the rally has reset.
articles._summary: Semiconductors, the year’s defining momentum bet, have reversed hard in two sessions with the sector benchmark — the iShares Semiconductor ETF (NASDAQ: SOXX ) — plunging 12.9%. The reading marks the sharpest two-day decline since March 2025. SOXX is still up 82% year-to-date, one of the strongest runs anywhere in the market. It began the year near $308 and changed hands above $562 on Thursday. At its June peak, the fund was higher by almost 115% on the year.
articles._zh_headline: SOXX ETF 一年多来最严重的 2 天跌幅：这 3 只筹码股现在上涨 50%
articles._zh_summary: 半导体是今年的决定性动能押注，但在两个交易日内出现大幅逆转，行业基准——iShares 半导体 ETF（纳斯达克股票代码：SOXX）——暴跌 12.9%。该读数标志着自 2025 年 3 月以来最大幅度的两天跌幅。SOXX 今年迄今仍上涨 82%，是市场上最强劲的涨幅之一。年初价格接近 308 美元，周四易手超过 562 美元。在 6 月份的峰值时，该基金同比上涨近 115%。
